name: PreferForehandSide

name: GraphNodeConst
evidence: byte-matched; regs[slot]=literal

name: GraphNodeSum

name: GraphNodeProduct
evidence: N-ary product of register slots

name: GraphNodeMax
evidence: N-ary maximum

name: GraphNodeSumOrInvalid

name: GraphNodeSub

name: GraphNodeDiv

name: GraphNodeLerp
evidence: out=a+clamp01(t)*(b-a)

name: GraphNodeInvLerp
evidence: out=clamp01((x-a)/(b-a))

name: GraphRegisterNodeKernels
evidence: registers 11 (node type crc32 -> kernel) pairs

evidence: fills per-node kernel pointer array at instance+0x38

name: GraphRunNodes
evidence: iterates def+0x1c node entries calling kernel pointers

name: CommitSwingChoice
